## Acceptance Criteria Quality (Measurability)

- [x] CHK013 Is the abidiff outcome specified with an objective pass criterion ("reports the change additive — no breaking re-definition")? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009/SC-005] — PASS: FR-009 reads "`abidiff` MUST report the change as additive (no breaking re-definition)"; SC-005 lists "abidiff reports the change additive" as a named gate. Objective: the tool either reports additive or it does not.
- [x] CHK014 Is the forward-compat outcome (a consumer recording minor 4 still works against the 0.5 engine; link-time-not-behavioural) defined as an objectively checkable acceptance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] — PASS: SC-006 states "a consumer recording minor 4 still works against the 0.5 engine (additive forward-compat; the new symbols are link-time, not behavioural downgrades)". The additive abidiff gate (CHK013) provides the objective check: no shipped-signature change means any consumer compiled against 0.4.0 headers links and runs unchanged against the 0.5 binary.
- [x] CHK015 Is the SC-005 surface-gate triple (golden passes / abidiff additive / occupancy unchanged / reentrancy all-annotated) each individually verifiable rather than bundled into one vague "gates pass"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — PASS: SC-005 enumerates four individually-named, tool-backed criteria: (1) "ABI-golden symbol gate passes with the new symbols" — named file + count; (2) "abidiff reports the change additive" — named tool + criterion; (3) "occupancy-drift gate passes unchanged" — named tool + no-edit condition; (4) "per-symbol reentrancy gate passes with every new symbol annotated" — named tool + 0-unannotated criterion. Each independently falsifiable.
